name: token-keeper
description: While any Claude Code session is open, keeps the OAuth login of one or more Claude config dirs fresh, so a rarely used account is not logged out.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.description: auto = ~/.claude plus every ~/.claude-* dir with a login; current = this session's own config dir only; or a comma-separated list of config dirs (~ allowed).

checkEveryMinutes.title: Check every (minutes)
checkEveryMinutes.description: How often the open sessions check the logins.

refreshBeforeMinutes.title: Refresh before expiry (minutes)
refreshBeforeMinutes.description: Refresh an account when its access token expires within this window (or already expired). A fresher token is never rotated.
